Modified assessment using the August 2021 Beige Book: While the FOMC statement highlights continued strengthening in activity and employment alongside highly accommodative financial conditions, the Beige Book reports a downshift to moderate growth amid Delta-related headwinds, acute labor shortages, rising wages, and persistent price pressures. These regional insights temper the otherwise positive SLOOS signal of easing credit standards and stronger loan demand. Netting the accommodative credit backdrop against real-side constraints and elevated inflation implies a moderately positive but more cautious tone than the SLOOS-alone read.
